caption:
Stock market news | SEBI pushes faster FPI entry and 3-day REIT listings

SEBI announced it will reduce foreign portfolio investor onboarding to five days and shorten REIT and InvIT listing timelines to three days. It also said it will review the LODR, ICDR and SME IPO frameworks.
The changes aim to speed capital entry, improve listing efficiency and update regulatory rules for smaller companies.
